title: apiverity project configuration
description: Project configuration for api-verity-lab. Generated from apiverity/core/config.py by scripts/generate_config_schema.py -- edit the module, not this file.

contracts.description: Glob patterns naming this project's contracts, e.g. ['api/**/*.yaml'].

profile.description: Severity profile: a starting position that every other setting overrides.

severity_overrides.description: Rule id -> severity. The persistent form of --severity-override.

fail_on.description: Lowest severity that fails a run. 'never' reports without failing, which is how you adopt the gate on an API that already has history.

check_semver.description: Check the version bump against the changes by default.

suggest_version.description: Recommend the next version by default.

suppression_max_days.description: How far ahead a suppression's `expires` date may sit, in days. Beyond it the entry does not suppress: an expiry far enough away is a permanent ignore with a date on it. Defaults to 90.

suppression_require_approver.description: Require every suppression to name an `approved_by` as well as an `owner`. Off by default -- a review model is a fact about a team, not about a contract.
